proposal.description: fault_reg is cleared all through soft start, as if each restart began a new record, as well as on a host read
proposal.reason: After a hiccup or other restart, the causes recorded in the previous episode are wiped as soon as the converter enters S_SS, before the host has read them. Causes that occur during soft start (OTP, UVLO, a window_trip_SS) also never appear in fault_reg until S_RUN.

proposal.description: OTP is recorded only when UVLO is not live, as if a brown-out made the OTP reading unreliable and UVLO took precedence
proposal.reason: If OTP and UVLO are both asserted while the converter is running, and OTP clears before UVLO, fault_reg shows only the UVLO bit and the OTP cause is lost.

proposal.description: The UVLO and OVERCURRENT cause bits are laid out in swapped positions, so overcurrent is ranked above UVLO
proposal.reason: A UVLO captured while running shows up in fault_reg as 00001 instead of 00010. A window_trip or window_trip_SS overcurrent shows up as 00010 instead of 00001.

proposal.description: fault_time is cleared when it sees the record empty, instead of on the host-read pulse itself, so it is cleared one clock after fault_reg
proposal.reason: On the clock after fault_reg_read_done, fault_reg is already zero but fault_time still holds the previous episode's start time. It clears only one clock later, so for that one clock the outputs give an empty record with a non-zero time.
